Dear Sir / Madam,  
 
Subject: Audio Recording - Earnings Calls for Q1 of FY 2026-27 
 
In continuation to our intimation vide ref. no. SBIL/CS/NSE-BSE/2627/63 dated  
July 20, 2026, we wish to inform you that pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 
read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the earnings conference calls 
with analysts or institutional investors held on Friday, July 24, 2026, with respect to the 
financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, has been hosted 
on the Company’s website. 
 
Please find below the link of Audio Recording of Earnings Calls held on Friday,  
July 24, 2026, with analysts or institutional investors. 
 
https://www.sbilife.co.in/en/about-us/investor-relations 
 
You are requested to kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
 
 
Girish Manik 
Company Secretary
